profile.summary: Professional Service Industries, Inc. (also called Intertek-PSI) is a company, part of Intertek, that provides construction assurance, testing and inspection for civil and commercial construction. Its services include construction materials testing, geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting and industrial hygiene. It operates through a national network of offices and laboratories, including an office in Oakland, California.
